display_long_description:
My MR Puppy brings a lovable virtual dog into your real room with the magic of Mixed Reality.

Meet your new playful companion, place its bed and food bowl, call it over, pet it with your hands, feed it treats, play fetch, and watch it explore your space like it truly lives there. Your puppy can walk around the room, bark, sit, sleep, react to your touch, follow you, get excited, and perform simple tricks with realistic dog animations and cute sound effects.

Designed as a cozy and relaxing MR pet experience, My MR Puppy focuses on simple daily moments that feel personal and heartwarming. Watch your dog roam across the real floor, rest in its bed, respond to commands, chase toys, and show affection when you interact with it.

Whether you want a calm companion, a playful puppy, or a fun Mixed Reality experience to share with friends and family, My MR Puppy turns your home into a warm virtual pet space.

Features:

A virtual puppy that lives inside your real room
Mixed Reality room-aware placement and movement
Petting, feeding, calling, fetch, sleeping, and tricks
Dog name selection
Food bowl and bed placement
Realistic dog animations
Cute bark, pant, happy, and petting sound effects
Heart effects and emotional reactions
Simple command menu
Playful activities and cozy daily interactions
A relaxing pet experience for all ages
